question: Who grabbed the most total rebounds this season?
ground_truth: Ivica Zubac led with 1008 total rebounds in 80 games, followed by Domantas Sabonis (973 in 70 games) and Karl-Anthony Towns (922 in 72 games).
answer: Ivica Zubac grabbed the most total rebounds this season with 1008 rebounds.
sql_query:
SELECT p.name, t.code AS team,
       s.reb AS total_rebounds,
       s.gp
FROM players p
JOIN teams t ON p.team_id = t.team_id
JOIN player_stats s ON p.player_id = s.player_id
WHERE s.season = '2024-25'
ORDER BY s.reb DESC
LIMIT 10;
